mapper.insert: INSERT INTO finance_payable (payable_no, source_type, source_id, purchase_order_id, supplier_id, supplier_name_snapshot, entry_type, original_payable_id, amount, event_at, reason, version, deleted, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{payableNo}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{purchaseOrderId}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierNameSnapshot}, #{entryType}, #{originalPayableId}, #{amount}, #{eventAt}, #{reason}, 0, FALSE, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (source_type, source_id) WHERE deleted = FALSE AND source_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS payableId, p.payable_no AS payableNo, p.purchase_order_id AS purchaseOrderId, p.supplier_id AS supplierId, p.supplier_name_snapshot AS supplierNameSnapshot, p.entry_type AS entryType, p.amount, po.purchaser_id AS purchaserId FROM finance_payable p LEFT JOIN purchase_receipt pr ON pr.id = p.source_id AND pr.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN purchase_order po ON po.id = pr.purchase_order_id AND po.deleted = FALSE WHERE p.id = #{targetId} AND p.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND p.deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE OF p
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM finance_payable WHERE original_payable_id = #{originalPayableId} AND entry_type = 'RED' AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT * FROM finance_payable WHERE id = #{payableId} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.sql: SELECT p.id AS payableId, p.payable_no AS payableNo, p.purchase_order_id AS purchaseOrderId, po.order_no AS purchaseOrderNo, p.supplier_id AS supplierId, p.supplier_name_snapshot AS supplierName, p.source_type AS sourceType, p.source_id AS sourceId, p.entry_type AS entryType, p.original_payable_id AS originalPayableId, original.payable_no AS originalPayableNo, p.amount, CASE WHEN p.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN p.amount - red.redAmount ELSE 0 END AS netAmount, CASE WHEN p.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN written.writtenOffAmount ELSE 0 END AS writtenOffAmount, CASE WHEN p.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN GREATEST(p.amount - red.redAmount - written.writtenOffAmount, 0) ELSE 0 END AS openAmount, CASE WHEN p.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN GREATEST(written.writtenOffAmount - (p.amount - red.redAmount), 0) ELSE 0 END AS overAppliedAmount, CASE WHEN p.entry_type <> 'NORMAL' THEN NULL WHEN written.writtenOffAmount = 0 THEN 'OPEN' WHEN GREATEST(p.amount - red.redAmount - written.writtenOffAmount, 0) = 0 AND GREATEST(written.writtenOffAmount - (p.amount - red.redAmount), 0) = 0 THEN 'SETTLED' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END AS settleState, p.event_at AS eventAt, p.due_date AS dueDate, p.reason FROM finance_payable p LEFT JOIN finance_payable original ON original.id = p.original_payable_id AND original.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN finance_payable normalSource ON normalSource.id = CASE WHEN p.entry_type = 'RED' THEN p.original_payable_id ELSE p.id END AND normalSource.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND normalSource.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN purchase_receipt pr ON pr.id = normalSource.source_id AND pr.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN purchase_order po ON po.id = pr.purchase_order_id AND po.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(red.amount), 0) AS redAmount FROM finance_payable red WHERE red.original_payable_id = p.id AND red.entry_type = 'RED' AND red.deleted = FALSE ) red ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN wo.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN wo.amount WHEN wo.entry_type = 'REVERSE' THEN -wo.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS writtenOffAmount FROM finance_write_off wo WHERE wo.target_type = 'PAYABLE' AND wo.target_id = p.id AND wo.deleted = FALSE ) written ON TRUE
mapper.select: WHERE p.original_payable_id = #{originalPayableId} AND p.entry_type = 'RED' AND p.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY p.event_at, p.id
